date_note: Date is the day CNN and NBC News published the report; the date of the intrusion is not stated.
title: FBI reported investigating apparent breach of its NCIC criminal information database
summary: NBC News reported on 20 November, citing two people briefed on the matter, that the FBI is investigating an apparent breach of the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), used to connect federal, state and local authorities. CNN, as relayed by AFP via Arab News, said the FBI was hacked for the second time since September. The FBI had no comment as of Friday night; who is responsible is unclear.
plain: News outlets report, citing unnamed people, that the FBI is investigating an apparent breach of NCIC, a database that connects US law enforcement. The FBI had no comment.
exec: A reported breach of a national law-enforcement database; the FBI had no comment and no attacker has been named.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Law-enforcement users should follow any FBI or agency notice about NCIC access.

validation.note: NBC News (two people briefed on the matter) and CNN via AFP/Arab News both report the apparent breach; neither quotes an FBI confirmation, so status stays developing.
